##Make new variables
```{r cars}
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
study <- study %>% mutate(htn=case_when(sbp<=120 & dbp<=80 ~0, sbp>120 & sbp<=130 & dbp<=80 ~1, sbp>130 | dbp>80~2))
target <- target %>% mutate(htn=case_when(sbp<=120 & dbp<=80 ~0, sbp>120 & sbp<=130 & dbp<=80 ~1, sbp>130 | dbp>80~2))
study$htn<- factor(study$htn, levels=c(0,1,2), labels=c("Normal","Elevated","Hypertension"))
target$htn<- factor(target$htn, levels=c(0,1,2), labels=c("Normal","Elevated","Hypertension"))
study$des<- factor(study$des, levels=c(0,1), labels=c("Placebo","DES 5mg"))

#create indivator for target vs Study
target$s<- 0
study$s<-1

```

study<- study %>% mutate(agecat= cut(age,c(-Inf,70,72,74,75,80,Inf)))
#linear for outocme 1?

#SPline for outocme 2? at 75

rates_event2$IR<-rates_event2$events/(rates_event2$persontime/30.5)

#IOSW
```{r}
#stack the datasets
#stacked dataset with common vars
stacked<- bind_rows(study,target)

#sanity check- shoul be same
dim(stacked)
dim(target)[1] + dim(study)[1]

#model for predicting selection into study from target
model_iosw<- glm(s~ age + wt_index + cvd + htn + tumor_size + stage,data=stacked, family =binomial(link='logit'))
summary(model_iosw)

#generate predicted probabilities in the study dataset
study$pred_s <- predict(model_iosw,newdata = study,type = "response")
study$odds_s<- study$pred_s/(1-study$pred_s)
study$iosw<- 1/study$odds_s

#check for one ID
View(study[which(study$id==3),c("age","wt_index","cvd","htn","tumor_size","stage","pred_s","odds_s","iosw")])
#0.715030 + 0.009670*69 + 0.00414*102 + (-0.789616*1) + 0.008892*1 + 0.005273*3 + (-0.821810*3)
#exp(-1.425795)/(1+exp(-1.425795))
#0.1937547 matches pred_s
```

#IPTW
```{r}
study<- study %>% mutate(age_knot75= case_when(age<75 ~0, age>=75~ age-75))
#convert des to a numeric version
study<- study %>% mutate(des_num=case_when(des=="DES 5mg"~1, des=="Placebo"~0))
model<- glm(des_num ~ age + wt_index + cvd + htn + tumor_size + stage, data=study, family=binomial(link='logit'))
study$pred_des<- predict(model,type="response")
study$iptw<- ((study$des_num)/(study$pred_des)) + ((1-study$des_num)/(1-study$pred_des))

#check for one ID
View(study[which(study$id==3),c("age","wt_index","cvd","htn","tumor_size","stage","pred_des","iptw")])
#0.843470 + -0.003523*69 + -0.012316*102 + (0.131036*1) + -0.049571*1 + -0.004077*3 + ( 0.178525 *3)
#exp(-0.05104)/(1+exp(-0.05104))
#0.4872428 matches pred_des


##########MAKE OVERALL WEIGHT###############
study$overall_wt <- study$iptw * study$iosw

```

#Question 3:
```{r}
#STRATIFY DATA BY TREATMENT
placebo = study[study$des_num==0,] 
DEG = study[study$des_num==1,]

#FIT OVERALL KM- 1 if ANY event, 0 otherwise
####PLACEBO####
KMO_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event > 0)) ~ 1, data = placebo,weights =iptw)
hO_P <- data.frame(times = KMO_P$time, s = KMO_P$surv)
####DEG####
KMO_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event > 0)) ~ 1, data = DEG,weights =iptw)
hO_D <- data.frame(times = KMO_D$time, s = KMO_D$surv)


#CAUSE_SPECIFIC : PROSTRATE
####PLACEBO####
KM1_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 1)) ~ 1, data = placebo, weights =iptw)
h1_P <- data.frame(times = KM1_P$time, d1 = KM1_P$n.event, n1 = KM1_P$n.risk, haz1 = KM1_P$n.event/KM1_P$n.risk)
####DEG####
KM1_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 1)) ~ 1, data = DEG, weights = iptw)
h1_D <- data.frame(times = KM1_D$time, d1 = KM1_D$n.event, n1 = KM1_D$n.risk, haz1 = KM1_D$n.event/KM1_D$n.risk)


#CAUSE_SPECIFIC : CVD
####PLACEBO####
KM2_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 2)) ~ 1, data = placebo, weights =iptw)
h2_P <- data.frame(times = KM2_P$time, d2 = KM2_P$n.event, n2 = KM2_P$n.risk, haz2 = KM2_P$n.event/KM2_P$n.risk)
####DEG####
KM2_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 2)) ~ 1, data = DEG, weights =iptw)
h2_D <- data.frame(times = KM2_D$time, d2 = KM2_D$n.event, n2 = KM2_D$n.risk, haz2 = KM2_D$n.event/KM2_D$n.risk)


#CAUSE_SPECIFIC : OTHER
####PLACEBO####
KM3_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 3)) ~ 1, data = placebo, weights =iptw)
h3_P <- data.frame(times = KM3_P$time, d3 = KM3_P$n.event, n3 = KM3_P$n.risk, haz3 = KM3_P$n.event/KM3_P$n.risk)
####DEG####
KM3_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == 3)) ~ 1, data = DEG, weights =iptw)
h3_D <- data.frame(times = KM3_D$time, d3 = KM3_D$n.event, n3 = KM3_D$n.risk, haz3 = KM3_D$n.event/KM3_D$n.risk)

library(tidyr)
#MERGE: we want 2 datasets; Placebo, DEG..each with all cause-specific haz and overall surv
####PLACEBO####
placebo_AJ <-  h1_P |> full_join(h2_P) |> full_join(h3_P) |> full_join(hO_P) |> 
  replace_na(list(d1 = 0, haz1 = 0, d2 = 0, haz2 = 0,d3 = 0, haz3 = 0)) |> arrange(times)

placebo_AJ <- placebo_AJ |> 
  mutate(aj1 = cumsum(haz1 * lag(s, default = 1)), 
         aj2 = cumsum(haz2 * lag(s, default = 1)), 
         aj3 = cumsum(haz3 * lag(s, default = 1)),
         composite = aj1 + aj2 + aj3, 
         composite2 = 1 - s)

###DEG####
DEG_AJ <-  h1_D |> full_join(h2_D) |> full_join(h3_D) |> full_join(hO_D) |> 
  replace_na(list(d1 = 0, haz1 = 0, d2 = 0, haz2 = 0,d3 = 0, haz3 = 0)) |> arrange(times)

DEG_AJ <- DEG_AJ |> 
  mutate(aj1 = cumsum(haz1 * lag(s, default = 1)), 
         aj2 = cumsum(haz2 * lag(s, default = 1)), 
         aj3 = cumsum(haz3 * lag(s, default = 1)),
         composite = aj1 + aj2 + aj3, 
         composite2 = 1 - s)

#MERGE THE RISKS FOR PLACEBO AND DEG
rdiff = merge(cbind(time = placebo_AJ$times,risk_P_O=placebo_AJ$composite, # Overall Time and risk for A=0
                    risk_P_1=placebo_AJ$aj1,risk_P_2=placebo_AJ$aj2,risk_P_3=placebo_AJ$aj3),
               # Overall Time and risk for A=1
                cbind(time = DEG_AJ$times,risk_D_O=DEG_AJ$composite,risk_D_1=DEG_AJ$aj1,
                      risk_D_2=DEG_AJ$aj2,risk_D_3=DEG_AJ$aj3),
                by = "time",all=TRUE)                # Outer merge risk data on time

rdiff = rdiff %>% 
  fill(c("risk_P_O","risk_D_O","risk_P_1","risk_D_1","risk_P_2","risk_D_2","risk_P_3","risk_D_3"),.direction="down")     # Forward-filling all missing risks on aligned times

rdiff$rd_O = with(rdiff, risk_D_O-risk_P_O)          # Computing the risk difference across columns
rdiff$rd_1 = with(rdiff, risk_D_1-risk_P_1)          # Computing the risk difference across columns
rdiff$rd_2 = with(rdiff, risk_D_2-risk_P_2)          # Computing the risk difference across columns
rdiff$rd_3 = with(rdiff, risk_D_3-risk_P_3)          # Computing the risk difference across columns


# display results
library(ggplot2)

plot_Q3<- ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = rdiff, aes(time, rd_O, colour = "Overall"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_step(data = rdiff, aes(time, rd_1, colour = "Prostate Cancer"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_step(data = rdiff, aes(time, rd_2, colour = "CVD"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_step(data = rdiff, aes(time, rd_3, colour = "Other"), linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Cause of Death",
    values = c(
      "Overall" = "black",
      "Prostate Cancer" = "blue",
      "CVD" = "red",
      "Other" = "green"
    )
  ) +
  
  xlab("Months since Randomization") +
  ylab("Risk Differences") +
  ggtitle("IPTW Weighted Risk Difference between DES 5 mg and Placebo")

```

#Question 5
```{r}
#THE BOOTSTRAPS!!!
#Compute the weights and weighted KM 200 times by randomly sampling wiht replacement.
library(boot)
#function for computing weights

calc_risk<- function(data, indices, event_) {
    d <- data[indices, ]
    stack<-bind_rows(d,target)
    #IOSW
    model_iosw<- glm(s~ age + wt_index + cvd + htn + tumor_size + stage,data=stack, family =binomial(link='logit'))

    d$pred_s <- predict(model_iosw,newdata = d,type = "response")
    d$odds_s<- d$pred_s/(1-d$pred_s)
    d$iosw<- 1/d$odds_s
    #IPTW
    model<- glm(des_num ~ age + wt_index + cvd + htn + tumor_size + stage, data=d, family=binomial(link='logit'))
    d$pred_des<- predict(model,type="response")
    model<- glm(des_num ~ age + wt_index + cvd + htn + tumor_size + stage, data=study, family=binomial(link='logit'))
d$iptw<- ((d$des_num)/(d$pred_des)) + ((1-d$des_num)/(1-d$pred_des))
    #Overall
    d$overall_wt <- d$iptw * d$iosw
    #make Placebo and DEG datasets
    placebo = d[d$des_num==0,] 
    DEG = d[d$des_num==1,]
    #OVERALL
    ####Placebb####
    KMO_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event > 0)) ~ 1, data = placebo,weights =overall_wt)
    hO_P <- data.frame(times = KMO_P$time, s = KMO_P$surv)
    ####DEG####
    KMO_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event > 0)) ~ 1, data = DEG,weights =overall_wt)
    hO_D <- data.frame(times = KMO_D$time, s = KMO_D$surv)


    #CAUSE_SPECIFIC : PROSTRATE
    ####PLACEBO####
    KM_P <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == event_)) ~ 1, data = placebo, weights =overall_wt)
    h_P <- data.frame(times = KM_P$time, d = KM_P$n.event, n = KM_P$n.risk, haz = KM_P$n.event/KM_P$n.risk)
    ####DEG####
    KM_D <- survfit(Surv(time, (event == event_)) ~ 1, data = DEG, weights =overall_wt)
    h_D <- data.frame(times = KM_D$time, d = KM_D$n.event, n = KM_D$n.risk, haz = KM_D$n.event/KM_D$n.risk)

library(purrr)
#MERGE: we want 2 datasets; Placebo, DEG..each with all cause-specific haz and overall surv
####PLACEBO####
placebo_AJ <- h_P |> full_join(hO_P) |> replace_na(list(d = 0, haz = 0)) |> arrange(times)

placebo_AJ <- placebo_AJ |> 
  mutate(aj = cumsum(haz * lag(s, default = 1)),
         composite = 1 - s)

###DEG####
DEG_AJ <- h_D |> full_join(hO_D) |> replace_na(list(d = 0, haz = 0)) |> arrange(times)

DEG_AJ <- DEG_AJ |> 
  mutate(aj = cumsum(haz * lag(s, default = 1)), 
         composite =1 - s)

#MERGE THE RISKS FOR PLACEBO AND DEG
rdiff = merge(cbind(time = placebo_AJ$times,risk_P_O=placebo_AJ$composite,  risk_P_event=placebo_AJ$aj),# Overall Time and risk for A=0
               # Overall Time and risk for A=1
                cbind(time = DEG_AJ$times,risk_D_O=DEG_AJ$composite,risk_D_event=DEG_AJ$aj),
                by = "time",all=TRUE)                # Outer merge risk data on time

rdiff = rdiff %>% 
  fill(c("risk_P_O","risk_D_O","risk_P_event","risk_D_event"),.direction="down")     # Forward-filling all missing risks on aligned times

rdiff$rd_O = with(rdiff, risk_D_O-risk_P_O)          # Computing the risk difference across columns
rdiff$rd_event = with(rdiff, risk_D_event-risk_P_event)          # Computing the risk difference across columns
return(rdiff$rd_event[rdiff$time==60])
}
set.seed(1)
b_prostrate<- boot::boot(data = study, statistic = function(data, idx) calc_risk(data=data, indices=idx,event_=1), R = 1000)
b_cvd<- boot::boot(data = study, statistic = function(data, idx) calc_risk(data=data, indices=idx,event_=2), R = 1000)
b_other<- boot::boot(data = study, statistic = function(data, idx) calc_risk(data=data, indices=idx,event_=3), R = 1000)
b_all<- boot::boot(data = study, statistic = function(data, idx) calc_risk(data=data, indices=idx,event_=c(1,2,3)), R = 1000)
#2.5th and 97.5th for LCL UCL
mean(b_prostrate$t)
quantile(b_prostrate$t,probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
mean(b_cvd$t)
quantile(b_cvd$t,probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
mean(b_other$t)
quantile(b_other$t,probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
mean(b_all$t)
quantile(b_all$t,probs = c(0.025, 0.975))


```
